choreography.startupIntent: Expose the front blade cassette with almost no torso travel.
choreography.heroContact: One razor-straight contact line; the first active cel may be the hero.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Snap the cassette shut and brake the shoulder without body drift.

choreography.startupIntent: Coil beneath centre line with the rear hip loaded.
choreography.heroContact: Rising diagonal blade/heel line driven through hip and shoulder together.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Overshoot high, then restore the digitigrade base through a visible brake.

choreography.startupIntent: Drop only enough to clear the front blade cassette.
choreography.heroContact: Fast low trace from hip turn and forearm extension.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Return the cassette before the knees unfold.

choreography.startupIntent: Load the rear digitigrade leg and cross the front forearm low.
choreography.heroContact: Trapping sweep that reads as a single hooked line without animal imitation.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: The rear leg brakes hard while the forearm retracts.

choreography.startupIntent: Fold the rear leg and bring the front cassette across the chest.
choreography.heroContact: Compact forward air cut crossing the torso line.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Blade retracts before the landing silhouette begins.

choreography.startupIntent: Fold sharply at apex and align the heel with the target line.
choreography.heroContact: Downward heel/blade strike with the torso kept trackable.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Hard brake into a low landing pose; no skating.

choreography.startupIntent: Preload both heels and rotate the sensor brow away from the target as a feint.
choreography.heroContact: Low route-change dash that passes the opponent's lead edge and cuts on the brake.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: One aggressive rearward brake restores facing and spacing.

choreography.startupIntent: Extend the declared forearm cassette and align the shoulder for a clean plane.
choreography.heroContact: Physically readable slash with a separate arc-energy cutting plane.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Blade retracts before the hip drive unloads.

choreography.startupIntent: Compress both arms across the core and lock the heels.
choreography.heroContact: Compact electrical reversal with the body still visible at the centre.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Electrical brake arcs while the forearms reopen.

choreography.startupIntent: Visor line and route grid lock while the chassis compresses to its lowest stable line.
choreography.heroContact: A sequence of precise route cuts, each body key connected through real hip and shoulder mechanics.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Afterimages continue beyond each real contact but never hide the true body.
choreography.recoveryIntent: The final cut exits into a violent mechanical brake and visible heat dump.

choreography.startupIntent: Hook the receiver's arm and hip with the two cassette housings.
choreography.heroContact: Spin around the receiver's centre and release into a fast lateral floor throw.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Brake facing the opponent and retract both blades.

superPresentation.entry: diagonal fast cut-in with a hard mechanical brake at full extension
superPresentation.bodyPriority: One real Viper remains trackable; route afterimages never replace physical contact keys.
